confirmedFindings.title: Dynamic JWT algorithm selection permits signature verification bypass
confirmedFindings.body: Passing the untrusted header.alg directly into jwt.verify allows attackers to forge tokens with alg: "none" or HMAC signature confusion.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Pin algorithms to a fixed whitelist: algorithms: ["RS256"].
